title: Using a derby or bucket as a mute
summary: Without a derby, players used buckets or cans as mutes; the tone was deeper than a sax.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition
